name: @peganahq/sdk-ts
description: Typed TypeScript client for the Pegana peg-risk oracle API — full OpenAPI-generated coverage of all /v1 endpoints, plus the stable v0.1 receipt-verification surface.
//entrypoints: These MUST point at the built dist/, not src/*.ts. 0.3.0 shipped broken because it declared the dist paths under `publishConfig`, which npm no longer honours for main/types/exports — it warns `Unknown publishConfig config` and publishes the src/*.ts paths verbatim, so `import` from node_modules throws ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING. `prepack` builds dist/ before packing. Repo-local development imports ../src/index.ts by relative path (see test/), so nothing here depends on these fields.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/schema.d.ts dist/schema.d.ts

//build: tsc does not emit declaration files for .d.ts INPUTS, so the OpenAPI-generated src/schema.d.ts never lands in dist/ — dist/typed.d.ts then imports './schema.js' and every consumer gets TS2307 'Cannot find module'. The runtime is unaffected (schema.d.ts is types-only), which is why only a real typed consumer catches it. Copy it explicitly.
